metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1985 · Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1989 · Dead Poets Society
metas.description: A maverick teacher at a prestigious New England boys' boarding school uses poetry to embolden his pupils to new heights of self-expression.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1988 · My Neighbor Totoro
metas.description: When two girls move to the country to be near their ailing mother, they have adventures with the wondrous forest spirits who live nearby.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1988 · Time of the Gypsies

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1987 · The Princess Bride
metas.description: A bedridden boy's grandfather reads him the story of a farmboy-turned-pirate who encounters numerous obstacles, enemies and allies in his quest to be reunited with his true love.
